sentences.text:
(IA No.77252/2023-EXEMPTION FROM FILING C/C OF THE IMPUGNED  JUDGMENT and IA No.77254/2023-CONDONATION OF DELAY IN REFILING /
 CURING THE DEFECTS )
 Date : 08-05-2023 This petition was called on for hearing today.

CORAM :
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE M.R. SHAH  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE C.T. RAVIKUMAR

For Petitioner(s) Mr. S. K. Chawla, Adv.
 Mr. Dinesh Verma, Adv.
 Mr. Subhasish Bhowmick, AOR

For Respondent(s)
 UPON hearing the counsel the Court made the following  O R D E R Delay in refiling is condoned.

As the acquisition is under the 1922 Act and not under the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, Section 24 (2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 shall not be applicable.
